effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_effect.des: Na-ebute ngwa agha na-egbu egbu na nchebe na-agafe mmebi ka oge na-aga. Ọ bụrụ na onye Soul Sorcerer kpatara ya, na-emebi mmebi dabere na pasentị dabere na ahụike kachasị nke ebumnuche.
effect.ibarnorigins.casting_soul_firebal: Mkpụrụ obi mgbaasị 'mkpụrụ obi ọkụ bọọlụ ike. Na-agba bọọlụ ọkụ mkpụrụ obi na mkpebi mmetụta.
effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_strength_e: Na-abawanye mmebi melee site na 50% na ọkwa 1 yana 100% na ọkwa 2.
effect.ibarnorigins.fire_weakness_effect: Na-abawanye mmebi sitere na isi mmalite ọkụ site na 100%.
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soul_burn.play: Mkpụrụ obi %1$s gbara ọkụ ka ọ na-agbalị ịgbanarị %2$s
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast: %1$s bụ ume nke mkpụrụ obi gbadoro anya tụbara ya
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast.play: %1$s bụ ike mkpụrụ obi gbadoro anya tufuo ya ka ọ na-agbalị ịgbanarị %2$s
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.name: Gaster
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.description: Ụmụ ndị dị anya nke Ghast bụ ndị a napụtara site na Nether na ndị ghọrọ mmadụ karịa n'ihi ogologo oge ha na-ekpughe na Overworld.
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.name: Onye aja
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.description: Ndị aja bụ ndị mmadụ bi n'ájá.
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.name: Soul afa
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.descript: A sub-agbụrụ nke ụmụ mmadụ na-enwe ike ịwa mkpụrụ obi ha ume.
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.name: Wraith akpọnwụ
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.descr: Ọkara ndị na-ebi ndụ ọkara-anwụghị anwụ bụ ndị ghọrọ ndị ike na-akpọnwụ kụnyere na-adịgide adịgide n'ihi njikọta na cores kpọrọ nkụ.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.name: Physique adịghị ike
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.descri: Agbanyeghi na ị na-emeziwanyewanye na Overworld, ị na-esighi ike n'anụ ahụ, okwute m ji nwayọ nwayọ, mebie 25% obere mmebi melee, ma nwee ike ịgwụ gị ngwa ngwa.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.name: Ngwa ngwa bọọlụ
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.descr: N'agbanyeghị na ekpughere gị n'ime ụwa karịrị akarị, ị jigidewo ike ịgba bọọlụ nke ndị nna nna gị, ruo n'ókè ụfọdụ opekata mpe.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.name: Ọnụ ego efu
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.descri: Ịwụ elu mgbe ị na-ezoro ezo ga-eme ka ị na-efe efe ma felie elu ruo obere oge.
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.name: Ki Nguzogide
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.descripti: Ị nwere ike iguzogide mmebi anwansi.
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.name: Obi ọkụ bọọlụ
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.description: Chekwaa bọọlụ ọkụ na-ere mkpụrụ obi pụrụ iche nke na-abawanye ike ka ọkwa ahụmịhe gị na-ebili (na-abawanye na ọkwa 100).
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_attributes.de: Were obere mmebi mgbe ị na-eguzo n'elu ihe mgbochi ájá mana naanị mebie 50% nke mmebi mgbe ọ bụla ọzọ karịa ájá. Na mgbakwunye, ị ga-amụba n'ọzara mgbe niile.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.name: Ngwunye ájá
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.desc: Ị nwere ike ịbanye n'ime ájá. Mgbe a na-eli ozu ị na-adịghị ahụ anya.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_shovel_damage: Were mmebi 150% karịa site na shọvel.
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.name: Ọsọ mkpụrụ obi
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.descriptio: Ike nke mkpụrụ obi na ájá mkpụrụ obi na ala mkpụrụ obi na-enye gị ohere ịga ngwa ngwa.
power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.des: Nweta ihe mmebi ọzọ 50% mgbe ị na-eguzo n'akụkụ isi ọkụ ọkụ ma ọ bụ na-ejide ihe ha. Ọzọkwa, iguzo ozugbo n'ime ọkụ mkpụrụ obi ga-ebuli ọgụ melee na mmebi 100% ọzọ yana mmebi bọọlụ ọkụ mkpụrụ obi 50%.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_fireweakness: N'agbanyeghị na ọ dị gị mma n'akụkụ ọkụ mkpụrụ obi, ọkụ na-ere mgbe niile na-esi na ọwa na ọkụ na-eme ka ike gwụ gị. Dị ka nke a, ị na-ewerekwa mmebi 100% ọzọ site na ọkụ wee kpuo ìsì mgbe ị na-emebi ọkụ.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_piglinfear.d: Ọkụ mkpụrụ obi mbụ na-ere n'ime gị na-akụnye egwu n'ime mmadụ niile ma ọ bụghị ndị Piglin nwere obi ike.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.d: Anụ enweghị ike mkpụrụ obi dịka akwụkwọ nri. N'ihi nke a, anụ anaghị akwado nnukwu ihe mana akwụkwọ nri na-enye ahụmịhe maka oriri dabere n'otú ha si ejupụta.
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.name: Okpokoro isi Wither na-achụso
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.descripti: Chekwaa ike nke undead na conjure skulls akpọnwụ na-achọ ndị iro gị.
power.ibarnorigins.wp_item_prevention.de: Ị nweghị ike iyi ihe agha ọ bụla dị elu karịa ngwa agha ígwè.
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.name: Ụgbọ elu
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.description: Ahụ gị dị ezigbo ọkụ ma nwee ike igwu mmiri n'ikuku.
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.name: Adịghị ike
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.description: N'ihi njikọta gị, ahụ gị dara nke ukwuu (obi 5) na ị nweghị ike ịwepụta nnukwu mmebi melee.
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.name: Ọkụ na-egbu egbu
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.description: Na nke ọ bụla hit, ị na-ebute ndị iro gị mmetụta nkụ.
